predictions.selection_reason: User-controlled markdown input -> parser.render() -> potentially unsafe HTML output if html option enabled
predictions.source_summary: raw parameter comes from NodeBB post content or signature content via filter:post.parse and filter:post.parseSignature hooks - user-controlled markdown input
predictions.sink_summary: parser.render() converts markdown to HTML which is then rendered in browser - potential XSS if HTML rendering is enabled
predictions.guard_summary: Remarkable parser configured with html:false by default, but configurable via admin settings; no additional sanitization applied to rendered HTML output
predictions.risk_pattern: User-controlled markdown input directly rendered to HTML without sanitization when html option is enabled
predictions.context_summary: markdownify function is registered as a filter hook for post parsing and signature parsing, receiving raw markdown content from user posts
unresolved_facts: Whether html option can be enabled via admin settings
Whether rendered HTML output is further sanitized by NodeBB framework

retrieval_query.mechanism_summary: markdown rendering with HTML enabled leading to cross-site scripting

top_sast_rules.cwe_name: Improper Encoding or Escaping of Output
top_sast_rules.description: Reinterpreting text from the DOM as HTML can lead to a cross-site scripting vulnerability.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Detect output operations that lack proper encoding for the target context
top_sast_rules.remediation: Use context-appropriate encoding for all output operations. Implement proper escaping for HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and URL contexts.

top_sast_rules.description: Modifying an object obtained via a user-controlled property name may lead to accidental mutation of the built-in Object prototype, and possibly escalate to remote code execution or cross-site scripting.
top_sast_rules.pattern: Look for security-sensitive operations that handle user input without proper validation or sanitization
top_sast_rules.remediation: Implement proper output encoding based on context (HTML, JavaScript, CSS, URL). Use Content Security Policy and validate input.
